[[File:Forgotten lockbox detail.png|130px|left]]
The '''forgotten lockbox''' is a drop received from defeating [[Yama]] that can be opened to obtain a reward. 

Each forgotten lockbox yields an average of approximately 3.45 [[oathplate shards]] and 28.54 [[dragon dart]]s. When the respective reward is rolled, it yields an average of approximately 11.82 oathplate shards or 104.55 dragon darts. Based on the lockbox's drop rate of 1/33 from Yama, lockboxes account for approximately 0.098 oathplate shards and 0.865 dragon darts per Yama kill.

==Trivia==
* The lockbox uses the same item model as the [[:File:Boss Slayer Master Blog (6).png|divine reliquary]], a proposed ammunition slot item that could store [[god blessing]]s. The reliquary, among other items, were proposed as a reward in the [[Update:Boss Slayer Master Blog|Boss Slayer Master Blog]] on [[14 July]] [[2020]], though the Boss Slayer Master and its rewards were ultimately scrapped and never polled.
* Attempting to open the lockbox on [[Entrana]] will present the player with the message "You can't open that here".
